quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026) consolidated results: net sales JPY 30,087,881 thousand, up 50.6%; operating profit JPY 7,733,176 thousand, up 174.5%; ordinary profit JPY 8,139,177 thousand, up 173.2% (helped by foreign-exchange gains and investment-property rent); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 6,210,694 thousand, up 179.1%. Management states the cost-of-sales ratio improved sharply because MG Co. (consolidated from October 2024) contributed for the full year and sales of relatively high value-added products rose. Net sales and operating profit were group records and reached the Master Plan 2022 targets for the fiscal year ending March 2027 (net sales 250 (100 million yen), operating profit 33 (100 million yen)) one year early.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 30,087,881 thousand (+50.6%); operating profit JPY 7,733,176 thousand (+174.5%); ordinary profit JPY 8,139,177 thousand (+173.2%); net profit JPY 6,210,694 thousand (+179.1%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 segment sales: Precision Machinery (precision molded parts, molds and precision metal parts for automotive and electronics) JPY 9,963,178 thousand, up 8.3%, a record: sales of automotive sensor-related parts held firm, while sales of parts for electric vehicles and of the molds to mass-produce them declined; MG Co. (automotive connectors and stationery parts such as ballpoint pen parts) has been included since Q4 of the prior year. Optical Products JPY 20,124,703 thousand, up 86.6%, a record: management states that as data-center construction advanced worldwide on the spread of generative AI, demand for optical communication components used inside data centers surged, sharply raising sales of data-center optical connectors and of the optical connector polishing machines and inspection / measurement equipment used to make them.
quarterly_data.figure: Precision Machinery JPY 9,963,178 thousand (+8.3%); Optical Products JPY 20,124,703 thousand (+86.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states demand for the group's optical connector polishing machines surged in FY2026, stretching the lead time from order to shipment to about two to three times the normal level. The company shifted in-house staff to the polishing-machine line, asked suppliers to raise volumes and added new suppliers, expanding polishing-machine production capacity about threefold in one year.
quarterly_data.figure: Polishing-machine lead time about 2 to 3 times normal; capacity about 3 times in one year

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 capital expenditure totalled JPY 1,073,676 thousand: Optical Products JPY 596,989 thousand (automated optical connector assembly machines, manufacturing equipment, inspection equipment), Precision Machinery JPY 386,932 thousand (injection molding machines, electrical discharge machines, 3D measuring machines), corporate JPY 89,752 thousand. Planned new equipment as of March 31, 2026 totals JPY 1,862,495 thousand, all starting April 2026: Optical Products at the Matsudo headquarters, Second and Third Plants JPY 540,565 thousand (machinery, molds, inspection equipment; completion March 2027), Hangzhou Seikoh Giken JPY 301,376 thousand, Dalian Seikoh Giken JPY 84,193 thousand, DATA PIXEL SAS JPY 71,400 thousand and SEIKOH GIKEN (THAILAND) JPY 22,500 thousand (each completing December 2026); Precision Machinery at Matsudo JPY 138,383 thousand, Fuji Electronics Industry JPY 367,017 thousand and MG Co. JPY 158,413 thousand; corporate JPY 178,648 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex JPY 1,073,676 thousand (Optical Products JPY 596,989 thousand); planned JPY 1,862,495 thousand (Matsudo optical JPY 540,565 thousand; Hangzhou JPY 301,376 thousand)

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expenses totalled JPY 666,561 thousand, of which Optical Products JPY 570,715 thousand. In Optical Products the company focused on multi-fiber optical connectors for ultra-high-speed, high-bandwidth parallel optical transmission in data centers and on CPO (Co-Packaged Optics) technology development toward commercialising photonic-electronic convergence, a faster, lower-power next-generation communication technology; it also developed optical transmission equipment, optical electric-field sensors and ultra-small resin lenses for non-telecom uses.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D expenses JPY 666,561 thousand; Optical Products JPY 570,715 thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Precision Machinery new product: the in-mold coating technology the company co-developed with Tokai Rika, which performs painting inside the mold, raises molding efficiency and cuts greenhouse-gas emissions in production by about 60%; sales activity has started for it as the in-mold coating system SSIMC, jointly with Sumitomo Heavy Industries.
quarterly_data.figure: Greenhouse-gas emissions in production cut by about 60%
